questions.q: Menene Avana?
questions.a:
Avana wata hanya ce ta ba da lamuni da aka gina don jinginar LP. Yana ba masu amfani damar saka matsayin AMM da ake goyan baya, su ci gaba da kasancewa masu aiki a cikin rijiyar da ke ƙasa, kuma su aro daga gare su ta hanyar tsarin Aave v4.

Babban ra'ayin shine cewa babban jari na LP ba dole ba ne ya zama ba za a iya amfani da shi ba kawai saboda yana cikin rijiyar. Avana yana canza matsayin LP da ake goyan baya zuwa jinginar da zai iya tallafawa bashi yayin da matsayi na asali ke ci gaba da tallafawa musayar kudi, samun kuɗi daga ƙimar ciniki, kuma ya ci gaba da kasancewa da alaƙa da kasuwar AMM dinsa.

questions.q: Wane matsala Avana ke warwarewa?
questions.a:
Masu samar da ruwa sau da yawa suna bukatar cire ruwa kafin su iya aro akan jarinsu. Wannan yana nufin ficewa daga pool, hakar damar samun kudin shiga, da katse matsayi a kasuwa da suka riga suka gina.

Avana yana warware wannan ta hanyar sanya matsayin LP da ake goyan baya a matsayin jinginar da za a iya amfani da shi. LP yana ci gaba da aiki, Avana yana bibiyar kuma yana kimanta matsayin, kuma Aave v4 yana kula da lissafin bangaren aro ta hanyar token jinginar cikin cikin gida.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ta bambanta da kasuwar lamuni ta yau da kullum?
questions.a:
Kasuwannin bashi na gargajiya yawanci suna ɗaukar jingina a matsayin ƙididdigar alamar sauƙi: ETH, BTC, stablecoins, ko wasu kadarorin ERC-20. An gina Avana don jingina da ke canza siffofi akan lokaci. Matsayin LP na iya ƙunsar dukiya da yawa, tara kuɗin shiga, motsi tare da canjin farashi, zama gefe ɗaya kawai, ko buƙatar hanya ta musamman don magancewa.

Saboda haka, Avana tana tantance jingina a matakin kasuwar LP. Kowace pool da aka tallafawa ko ƙungiyar LP na iya samun nasa hanyoyin kimanta, abubuwan jingina, kadarorin da za a iya karɓa, tsammanin lalacewa, da iyakokin haɗari.

questions.q: Wadanne AMMs Avana zai iya tallafawa?
questions.a:
Avana tana tallafawa kasuwannin LP da aka tsara musamman a cikin AMMs kamar Uniswap, Balancer, Curve, da Aerodrome yayin da ake ƙaddamar da kasuwanni. Tallafi ana ba da shi daga rijiyar da aka yarda zuwa rijiyar da aka yarda, ba ta atomatik ga kowace rijiyar a cikin wuri ba.

Kowane kasuwa da aka tallafawa yana da buƙatu masu bayyana: dogaro da farashin kadarori, isasshen zurfin ruwa, hanyar warwarewa da aka bayyana, iyakacin kasuwa, da saitunan jingina da suka dace da nau'in rijiyar. Wannan shine dalilin da ya sa kasuwannin ƙaddamarwa suke kasancewa an tsara kafin faɗaɗa rufin gaba ɗaya.

questions.q: Shin Avana yana maye gurbin AMM inda kuɗin ruwa na yake?
questions.a:
A'a. Har yanzu AMM yana kula da musayar kuɗi, yanayin pooln, motsin farashi, da samar da kuɗin sabis. Avana yana ƙara wani matakin jinginar kuɗi da bashi a kusa da matsayin LP da ake tallafawa.

Lokacin da ka ajiye matsayi mai cancanta a Avana, tsarin yana bin diddigin jinginar LP na ainihi kuma yana haɗa shi da lissafin ɓangaren aro. Asalin AMM shine wurin da matsayin ruwa yake da kuma inda ake samun kuɗin sabis.

questions.q: Ta yaya Avana ke aiki a babban mataki?
questions.a:
Avana yana aiki a cikin matakai uku. Na farko, mai amfani yana ajiye matsayin LP da aka goyi baya a cikin Avana. Na biyu, Avana yana tantance matsayin ta hanyar duba kadarorin da ke karkashinsa, tsarin pooln, canjin farashi, dangantaka, zurfin ruwa, da haɗarin sayarwa. Na uku, da zarar matsayin ya wuce tantancewar kasuwa, mai amfani zai iya aro bisa ƙimar da aka daidaita ta haɗarin.

Matsayin LP yana ci gaba da kasancewa a cikin AMM. Avana yana sarrafa bayanan jinginar, kimanta ƙima, da ka'idar haɗari ta musamman ga LP, yayin da Aave v4 ke kula da lamuni da lissafin bashi ta hanyar haɗin tsarin Hub-and-Spoke.

questions.q: Me yasa Avana ke amfani da tsarin Aave v4 Hub-and-Spoke?
questions.a:
Avana tana amfani da Aave v4 saboda jinginar LP na buƙatar raba ruwa da kuma hankali na haɗari da kansa a lokaci guda. Hub ɗin yana sarrafa abin da ya shafi kudi gama gari: ajiyar kuɗi, lissafin asusu, samfuran kudin ruwa, da daidaiton bashi na duniya.

Spokes suna kula da aikin LP na musamman: rajistar jinginar pooln, ƙimar matsayin, tilasta haɗari, da aiwatar da sayarwa. Wannan yana ba da damar tafkuna masu daidaito, ma'aurata masu alaƙa, ma'aurata masu canzawa, da kasuwannin ruwan da ke mai da hankali su yi amfani da ƙa'idodin da suke buƙata maimakon a tilasta su shiga cikin ɗaya samfurin haɗari na gama gari.

questions.q: Menene Zuƙowar Ara?
questions.a:
A Borrow Spoke kasuwa ce ta LP-collateral da aka ware. Yana yanke shawarar wane pools ake tallafawa, yadda ake kimanta kowanne matsayi na LP, waɗanne abubuwan haɗari ne suka shafi, waɗanne kadarori za a iya aro, da yadda aikin kwace ya ke aiki a wannan kasuwa.

Ana ware Borrow Spokes saboda matsayi na LP ba sa aiki iri ɗaya. LP na stablecoin, LP na ETH da aka ajiye a matsayin ETH wanda ke da alaƙa, da LP na token na mulki mai rashin kwanciyar hankali suna buƙatar saitunan haɗari daban, iyaka daban, kuma wani lokacin hanyoyin kwace daban.

questions.q: Menene alamun Avana vault?
questions.a:
Vault tokens suna daga cikin kadarorin lissafin ERC-20 na ciki waɗanda ke wakiltar amincewar LP collateral a gefen Aave na tsarin. Misali, matsayin LINK/ETH da aka tallafa zai iya dacewa da token ɗin collateral na vaultLINKETH, yayin da matsayin WETH/USDC zai iya dacewa da token ɗin vaultWETHUSDC.

Vault token shine gada. Avana yana bin diddigin ainihin matsayin LP da ƙimar sa, Aave Adapter yana samar da token ɗin vault ɗin da ya dace cikin Aave v4, kuma Aave yana amfani da wannan token ɗin don lissafin collateral. Mai amfani ba ya aron wani abu kawai daga cikin rufaffen abu; vault token har yanzu yana da goyon baya daga matsayin LP da ake bin diddiginsa a bayansa.

questions.q: Menene manyan sassan tsarin Avana?
questions.a:
Avana an gina shi ne a kusa da wasu ƙananan fasaloli. Manajan Matsayin LP yana rikodin ainihin matsayin LP, ciki har da mai shi, pool, ma'aurata, matakin kuɗi, kewaye, ruwa, ƙimar yanzu, kuɗaɗen da ake samu, da matsayin jinginar. Sashin Hadarin yana amincewa da pool, kadarori, zurfi, kewaye, da iyakokin kasuwa kafin matsayin ya tallafa bashin.

Sashin Jingina yana ɗaukar farashi, yana ƙima matsayin, yana yanke shawarar adadin jinginar da aka tallafawa, sannan yana ƙirƙira ko cire alamar gidan ajiyar cikin gida. Mai Haɗawa na Aave yana kula da gefen fuskar Aave ta hanyar samar da jinginar gidan ajiyar, ja ta, da kuma kiyaye haɗin Aave daban daga dabarun LP da suka shafi musamman.

questions.q: Me ke faruwa lokacin da na ajiye jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Lokacin da kuka ajiye matsayi na LP mai tallafi, Avana yana yin rikodin matsayi kuma ya tura shi zuwa cikin Magana mai dacewa. Yarjejeniyar tana tabbatar da cewa an amince da pooln, sake gina matsayi, duba saitunan haɗarin sa, kuma yana lissafin ƙimar jinginar da ke haɗe da wannan kasuwar. 

Da zarar matsayi ya share waɗancan rajista, Avana ya ƙirƙiri alamar ajiyar cikin gida don asusun bashi. Ajiya ba ya aro kadarorin ta atomatik; yana ƙirƙirar ƙarfin aro wanda asusun zai iya amfani da shi yayin da yake da lafiya kuma kasuwa tana da ruwa.

questions.q: Shin matsayin LP na zai ci gaba da aiki bayan ajiya?
questions.a:
Eh. Matsayin LP da ake goyan baya yana ci gaba da aiki yayin da yake a matsayin jingina. Ruwa yana ci gaba da kasancewa da alaƙa da matsayin AMM na asali, don haka pooln yana ci gaba da sarrafa musayar kuɗi kuma matsayin yana ci gaba da tara kuɗi da fa'idodi gwargwadon ka'idodin AMM.

Ana duba ayyukan da ke canza ƙimar jingina ta Avana yayin da bashi yake buɗe. Cire ruwa, karɓar kuɗi, canza iyaka, ko gyara matsayin yana wucewa ta Borrow Spoke saboda waɗannan ayyukan suna shafar ƙimar da ke goyan bayan aro.

questions.q: Shin zan iya karɓar kuɗin LP yayin da nake aro?
questions.a:
Avana yana raba babban kuɗin da aka tara daga kudaden da aka samu a cikin samfurin ƙimarsa. Wannan yana ba da damar tsarin ya gane kuɗin kuɗi da saki kuɗaɗen da za a iya karɓa yayin da yake ci gaba da amfani da babban kuɗin LP a matsayin jingina.

Ƙorafin kuɗi suna wucewa ta gwaje-gwajen lafiya kafin da bayan. Idan cire ƙimar kuɗin ya bar asusun ƙasa da iyakar jingina da ake buƙata, Avana yana toshe korafin har sai mai amfani ya dawo da bashi ko ya ƙara jingina.

questions.q: Shin kudaden LP suna cikin ƙimar jingina?
questions.a:
Ana bin diddigin kudaden da aka tara daban daga kudin asali na ruwa. Samfuri na Avana na oracle yana bambance darajar asali daga darajar kudade, don haka tsarin yana fahimtar yadda yawan matsayin shine babban ruwa da kuma yadda yawan kudaden da za a iya karɓa.

Wannan bambanci yana da mahimmanci yayin sayarwa. Avana yana amfani da kudaden da aka tara kafin kudin asali na ruwa lokacin da hanyar kasuwa ta goyi bayansa, wanda ke rage yawan babban matsayin LP da dole a rabu da shi don biya bashin.

questions.q: Yaushe zan iya janye jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Za ka iya janye jinginar bayan an biya bashi gaba ɗaya, ko bayan Avana ta tabbatar cewa sauran asusun har yanzu yana wuce gwaje-gwajen lafiya bayan janyewar. Biyan bashi gaba ɗaya shine hanyar janye jinginar mafi tsafta domin matsayin LP ba ya ƙara tallafawa buɗaɗɗen bashi.

Canje-canjen jinginar wani ɓangare suna wuce ta Borrow Spoke. Avana tana sake lissafin asusun bayan cirewa ko gyara matsayin LP da aka nema, sannan tana sakin jinginar ne kawai idan sauran jinginar da aka amince da ita har yanzu tana tallafawa bashin da ke akwai.

questions.q: Yaya Avana ke ƙayyade farashin jinginar LP?
questions.a:
Avana yana kayyade darajar jinginar LP ta hanyar sake gina matsayin da kimanta dukiyar da ke cikinsa. Ga LPs masu musanya, tsarin yana samo daraja daga farashin dukiya na waje da sake gina ma'aunin pooln. Ga ruwa mai mai da hankali, yana raba matsayin ta hanyar ruwa, kewayon, tazarar yanzu, fuskantar alamar kuɗi, da kuɗin da aka tara.

Sakamakon ana rage shi zuwa cikin darajar jingina da za a iya dawo da ita. Ikon aron kudi yana dogara ne akan abin da matsayin zai iya tallafawa cikin gaske bisa ga ƙididdigar haɗarin kasuwa, ba bisa ga ƙimar dukiya ta gaskiya ta muryar fata ba.

questions.q: Ta yaya Avana ke rage haɗarin oracle da farashi?
questions.a:
Avana tana amfani da tsarin farashi na dual-oracle don jinginar LP. Kayan farashin Chainlink suna bayar da babban ma'auni ga kadarorin da ke ƙasa, yayin da TWAPs da aka samo daga AMM ke aiki a matsayin matakin tabbatarwa na musamman daga ruwa na onchain.

Ana bayar da damar aro ne kawai idan tushen farashin suna cikin iyakokin kasuwa. Wannan yana rage fuskantar damfara ta flash-loan, canje-canje na wucin gadi na farashin AMM, sabuntawa marasa sabo, da kuma alamomin jinginar marasa kyau waɗanda ke haifar da bashin da ba lafiya.

questions.q: Menene darajar da za a iya farfado da ita?
questions.a:
Darajar da za a iya dawo da ita ita ce darajar jinginar da aka ragin kashi da Avana ke amfani da ita don yanke shawarar aro da sayar da jinginar. Yana nuna abin da matsayin LP ya kai bayan la'akari da hanyarsa ta warwarewa, siyarwa, canja wuri, ko biyan bashin a ƙarƙashin matsin lamba.

Darajar da za a iya dawo da ita tana ƙasa da darajar LP ta tunani idan hanyar sayar da jinginar ta haɗa da jinkiri, tasirin farashi, motsin kewayon, canjin ƙima, sarrafa kuɗin sabis, ko iyakance zurfin hanya. Avana tana daidaita aro bisa darajar da za a iya dawo da ita saboda wannan shi ne darajar da ke kare bashi.

questions.q: Me ya sa ake kula da matsayin tsarin mai yawa na ruwa da kyau?
questions.a:
Matsayin liquidity mai tsanani yana canza haɗari cikin sauri yayin da farashi ke motsawa. Matsayi zai iya zama mafi yawa ɗaya daga cikin kadarori, fita daga kewaye, daina samun kuɗin aiki, ko buƙatar biyan kuɗi a matakin cikakken matsayi na NFT.

Avana yana ƙima matsayi mai tsanani ta hanyar rarrabe ainihin yanayin matsayi maimakon ɗaukar NFT a matsayin daidaitaccen ma'aunin token. Kasuwa sai ta yi amfani da abubuwan haɗi na jinginar da kuɗi, iyakoki, da tsammanin sayarwa waɗanda suka dace da kewaye na matsayi, adadi, da haɗarin rufe matsayi.

questions.q: Wadanne bayanan kasuwa ne Avana ke lura da su?
questions.a:
Masu lura da Bashin Spokes suna sa ido kan sigina da ke shafar ingancin jinginar LP: hadewar pooln, farashin token, dangantakar kadarori, girgiza, zurfin ruwa, tarin kuɗi, amincin oracles, da farashin warwarewa.

Wadannan sigina suna ciyar da hanyoyin gudanar da jinginar kasuwa. Tafkuna masu kwanciyar hankali da matukar dacewa suna samun iyakoki daban da ma'aurata masu motsi ko ma'aurata da ba a kasuwanta sosai saboda bambancin bayanan sayarwa da ragin su yake daban.

questions.q: Yaya aro ke aiki a Avana?
questions.a:
Karɓar aron kuɗi yana faruwa ne bayan Spoke ɗin Bashi ya amince da kuma kimanta jinginar LP ɗinka. Lokacin da ka nema wani kadara, spoke ɗin yana duba ƙarfin da ya rage, ya tabbatar cewa matsayin yana nan lafiya bayan sabon bashi, kuma yana ɗaukar ruwa daga Hub idan kadara tana akwai.

An aika kadarar da aka aro zuwa ga mai amfani, kuma asusun yana rikodin bashi ta hanyar matakin lissafin ɓangaren aro. Sha'awa tana tarawa a lokaci, don haka lafiyar na iya canzawa ko da matsayin jingina kanta bai canza ba.

questions.q: Yaya ake ƙididdige ƙarfin aron kudi?
questions.a:
Iyawar aro tana fitowa ne daga darajar da aka daidaita bisa hadarin wuraren LP da aka amince da su a cikin Borrow Spoke. Avana yana sake gina kowace matsayi, yana kimanta haɗarin da ke tattare da shi, yana amfani da maganin haɗari na matakin pool, sannan yana amfani da hanyar jinginar kasuwa.

Borrow Spoke yana ba da rahoton wannan iyawa zuwa Hub don aiwatarwa. Lokacin da mai amfani yana da wurare da dama da aka amince da su a cikin kasuwa guda, Avana yana haɗa iyawarsu yayin da har yanzu yake kimanta kowace matsayi bisa ga poolnta, iyakarta, ruwan jari, da tsammanin haɗarin ta.

questions.q: Me ya sa ƙarfin aron ya ƙasa da ƙimar LP nawa?
questions.a:
Ikon aro yana ƙasa saboda Avana yana amfani da darajar jingina ta hankali, ba cikakken alamar LP ba. Matsayin LP na iya rasa ƙima ta hanyar bambancin farashi, asara mai ɗan lokaci, juyin kewaye, matsin lamba na ruwa, da yuwuwar sayarwa.

Bambanci tsakanin ƙimar LP da ikon aro shi ne matattarar aminci. Yana kare kasuwa ta tabbatar da cewa bashi an daidaita shi da ƙimar jingina mai iya dawowa maimakon mafi kyawun ƙima da aka nuna a lokacin yanayi na al'ada.

questions.q: Waɗanne kadarorin zan iya aro?
questions.a:
Dukiyar da za a iya aro ana saita ta bisa kasuwa. Kasuwannin aro na Avana sun mayar da hankali kan dukiyoyin da ake iya sayarwa cikin sauri kamar manyan stablecoins, GHO, ETH, BTC, da sauran dukiyoyin da suka dace da ruwan kasuwa, iyaka, da tsarin haɗari.

Fuskar mai amfani tana nuna saitin aron da ake da shi a kowace kasuwa. Nau'in jinginar LP da ake tallafawa baya bude dukiyar aron ta atomatik; kowace dukiyar bashi tana cikin tsarin kasuwa.

questions.q: Shin zan iya aro akan matsayi da dama na LP a lokaci guda?
questions.a:
I, idan matsayi suna samun goyon baya a cikin kasuwar da ta dace. Avana na iya haɗa ƙarfin aro a fadin wurare da dama da aka amince da su na LP a cikin Ƙananan Rantsarwa na Borrow, yana ba mai amfani ɗaya haɗa fuskar bashi don wannan kasuwa.

Haɗuwa ba ta haɗa haɗari ba tare da tunani ba. Kowanne matsayi har yanzu yana bayar da ƙarfin a bisa poolnsa, kewayon, ruwa, kuɗi, da tsarin kula da haɗari, kuma jimillar asusun dole ne ta kasance sama da matakin lafiya da ake buƙata.

questions.q: Yaya masu bayar da rance ke amfani da Avana?
questions.a:
Masu bayar da lamuni suna samar da kadarori kamar ETH, BTC, GHO, USDC, USDT, ko wasu kadarorin da aka tallafawa cikin bangaren da masu bayar da lamuni ke gani na tsarin. Wannan babban jari yana wucewa ta Hub don tallafawa aro a kasuwannin jinginar LP.

Masu bayar da lamuni ba su sarrafa iyakokin LP, asarar wucin gadi, ko ayyukan jinginar da suka shafi AMM kai tsaye. Spokes na aro suna kula da tantance LP da tsarin kwace, yayin da babban jari na mai bayar da lamuni ke karfafa matakin bashi.

questions.q: Daga ina ake samun amfanin mai kaya?
questions.a:
Riba daga mai bayarwa tana fitowa ne daga masu aro da ke biyan ruwa don samun damar kudade da ke da goyon bayan jinginar LP. Samfurin Avana yana hada farashin asali na Hub da ribar haɗin haɗari a matakin spoke da ke da alaƙa da kasuwannin LP da ake ba da kuɗi.

Wannan yana nufin riba na iya nuna amfani na yau da kullum da kuma ƙarin buƙata da aro mai goyon bayan LP ya haifar. Farashin har yanzu suna motsawa tare da yanayin kasuwa, kudaden da ake da su, amfani, da kuma halin haɗari na kasuwannin masu aro na asali.

questions.q: Shin masu bayar da rance suna sarrafa jingina na LP da kansu?
questions.a:
A'a. Masu ba da rance suna samar da babban jari mai tsabta cikin kasuwannin ba da rance da ake tallafawa. Ba su zaɓar iyakokin LP, ba su ƙara da'awar kuɗin LP, ko yanke shawarar yadda za a warware wani matsayi na AMM na musamman ba.

Wannan rarrabewa shi ne manufar Lend Spoke. Jarin mai ba da rance yana tallafawa bukatun masu aro na musamman da ke da goyon bayan LP yayin da Borrow Spokes ke kiyaye kimar jingina, duba lafiyar, da kula da wararwa daga aikin mai ba da rance.

questions.q: Menene ke kare babban jarin mai bayar da aron kudi?
questions.a:
Avana yana kare jarin mai bayar da bashi ta hanyar aro da ya wuce ƙimar jinginar, kiyasin ƙimar LP cikin hankali, dubawa ta masu bada hasashe biyu, iyakokin kasuwa, aiwatar da yanayin lafiya, da hanyoyin sayar da LP na musamman. Kowace Hanya ta Bashi tana ƙididdige ƙimar jinginar bisa ga haɗarin pooln nata kafin a ja bashi daga ruwan hub.

Dandalin har yanzu yana ɗauke da haɗarin DeFi: haɗarin kwangilar wayo, haɗarin hasashe, haɗarin aiwatar da sayarwa, da damuwar kasuwa. Avana na ƙunsar wannan haɗari ta hanyar auna jinginar LP a matakin kasuwa maimakon kallon kowace matsayin LP kamar daidaiton token mai sauƙi.

questions.q: Menene babban abin lafiya?
questions.a:
Matsayin lafiya yana auna dangantaka tsakanin ƙimar jinginar da aka daidaita bisa haɗarin da basussuka da ake da su a cikin Borrow Spoke. Ƙirar da aka sauƙaƙa ita ce ƙimar jinginar da aka daidaita ta kasu da basussukan da ake da su.

Ƙimar jinginar da aka daidaita ta riga ta haɗa da ƙimar LP na Avana, abubuwan jinginar, maganar haɗarin matakin pool, da ƙimar da za a iya mai da ita. Idan lafiyar ta fadi kasa da iyakar warwarewar, matsayin zai zama cancanta don warwarewa.

questions.q: Me ke shafar lafiyata?
questions.a:
Yanayin kiwon lafiya yana canzawa lokacin da darajar jingina ta canza, canje-canjen bashi, ana da'awar kudade, an cire jingina, an ƙara ƙarfi, ko sabunta sigogin kasuwa. Matsayi na LP na iya canzawa saboda farashin alamar yana motsawa, canje-canjen kaya, kudade suna haɓaka, ko matsayi mai mayar da hankali yana motsawa a ciki da wajen kewayon. 

Ƙarin bashi yana rage lafiya saboda bashi yana tashi. Biyan bashi, ƙara jinginar da aka amince da shi, ko rage fallasa yana inganta lafiya saboda asusun yana da ƙarin tallafi dangane da bashi.

questions.q: Yaya ake gudanar da sulhun kudi a Avana?
questions.a:
Fitar da kudi yana farawa lokacin da lafiyar asusun ta fadi ƙasa da iyakar fitar da kudi. Aave na kula da lissafin bashi, duba lafiya, da kuma wurin shigar da fitar da kudi akan jinginar ajiyar ERC-20.

Avana na kula da biyan LP bayan wannan alamar ajiyar. Adapter yana ƙone jinginar ajiyar, yana daidaita fitar da kudi zuwa ga hakikanin matsayi na LP, sannan matakin biyan kuɗi yana bin hanyar kasuwa: warware, sayarwa, kasuwar ajiya, ko canja wurin matsayi mai tallafi. Ana biyan bashin farko, sannan ladan wanda yake fitar da kudi da kuɗin biyan, tare da abin da ya wuce ana sarrafa shi bisa ƙa'idar kasuwa.

questions.q: Wanene zai iya warware matsayi mai rashin lafiya?
questions.a:
Ana yin sassauta basussuka ba tare da izini ba lokacin da matsayi ya wuce iyakar sassautawa. Duk wani mai sassautawa da ya cancanta zai iya biya adadin bashin da aka yarda kuma ya kunna hanyar biyan fansa.

Kudade na LP sun fi wahalar ja da baya fiye da na kuɗin al'ada, don haka Avana kuma yana la'akari da tsarin rufe sassauta na musamman. Masu sassautawa suna bibiyar irin wannan yanayin haɗari, daidaita rumbun-tokem, zurfin hanya, da ƙayyade dawo da amfani da shirin ke amfani da su.

questions.q: Me ke faruwa da kudaden LP yayin warwarewa?
questions.a:
Avana yana bambance kudaden da aka tara daga babban ruwan kuɗi na asali. A lokacin warwarewa, hanyar biyan kuɗi tana amfani da kudaden da aka tara kafin babban ruwan kuɗi lokacin da hanyar kasuwa ta goyi bayan wannan tsari.

Wannan yana rage yawan matsalar da zai iya faruwa ga matsayin LP na asali. Idan ƙimar kuɗi ba ta rufe isasshen bashi ba, matakin biyan kuɗi zai warware ko ya canja wurin jinginar LP da ake buƙata bisa ga hanyar warwarewar kasuwar.

questions.q: Ta yaya ake ƙara sabbin tafkunan LP?
questions.a:
Ana ƙara sabbin ruwan LP ta hanyar bita da amincewa da kasuwa. Wata pooln yana buƙatar sahihan farashin kadarorin da ke ƙasa, isasshen ruwa, tabbataccen hasashen sakin hannun jari, da iyakokin haɗari da suka dace da nau'in jinginar.

Avana tana farawa da kasuwannin LP da aka zaɓa don haka ƙimar da sayar da su suna tsabta. Rufe ruwan da ya fi yawa zai iya faɗaɗa a hankali yayin da goyon bayan oracles, zurfin ruwa, da bayanan haɗari suka inganta.

questions.q: Shin ƙididdigar haɗari na iya canzawa bayan kaddamarwa?
questions.a:
I, Ee. Za a iya canza ƙa'idodin haɗari yayin da yanayin kasuwa ya canza. Wani pool na iya zama ƙasa da ruwa, mai canzawa sosai, ƙasa da haɗin kai, ko kuma mai wahalar warwarewa fiye da yadda yake lokacin da aka fara jera shi.

Sabunta ƙa'idodi na iya shafar abubuwan ajiyar lamuni, iyakoki, tafkuna da ake tallafawa, kadarorin da za a iya aron su, dakatarwa, iyakokin sayar da kadarori, da ladan sayar da kadarori. Masu amfani da basussuka da ke buɗe suna bin waɗannan sabuntawa saboda canje-canjen ƙa'idodi na shafar ƙarfi aro da matakin lafiya.

questions.q: A ina zan bi tattaunawar gudanarwa?
questions.a:
Yawancin sabuntawa na shugabanci na Avana da tattaunawar kasuwa suna faruwa ta hanyar Avana Labs a X a https://twitter.com/avana_labs. Wannan tashar tana rufe sabbin tafkuna, ma'aunin kasuwa, hadewa, bita na tsaro, da matakan samfur.

Tsare-tsaren dogon lokaci, bayanan haɗari, da layukan shugabanci na waje suna haɗe daga Avana Labs lokacin da suka dace. Don manyan matsayin kudi, masu amfani suna duba sabbin sabuntawa na Avana Labs da ma'aunin kasuwa na yau da kullum kafin dogara ga pooln.

questions.q: Shin kudaden haɗin gwiwa na iya canzawa lokaci zuwa lokaci?
questions.a:
Eh. Kudin sabis da na fuska na Avana su ne saitunan aiki don manyan fuskan shafi na hukuma. Suna daban da muhimman ka'idojin tsarin da ke kula da jinginar da bashi, duba wuni, da lalacewa.

Lokacin da ake amfani da kudin fuska, tsarin mu'amala yana nuna shi kafin sa hannu domin masu amfani su iya bambance kudin fuska daga iskar gas, aiwatar da musayar, riba na tsarin, da tattalin lalacewa.

questions.q: Zan iya aro GHO ta hanyar Avana?
questions.a:
GHO ɗaya ne daga cikin kadarorin da Avana ke tallafawa a ɓangaren aron kuɗi don kasuwannin da suka haɗa da ruwa na GHO. Lokacin da kasuwa ta bayar da GHO, masu amfani za su iya aron ta da jinginar LP da aka amince da shi yayin da asusun ke daidai da mafi ƙarancin matakin lafiya da ake buƙata.

Aro GHO yana aiki kamar kowanne irin kadarar bashi a Avana: yana ƙara bashin da ake da shi, yana shafar nau'in lafiya, yana tara ruwa, kuma ana biya da GHO da kowane cajin da ya dace.

questions.q: Shin GHO na iya zama wani ɓangare na jinginar LP?
questions.a:
I, GHO na iya zama wani ɓangare na jinginar LP idan an amince da takamaiman rukunin GHO don kasuwar Avana. Ana kimanta rukunin kamar sauran kasuwannin LP: farashin kayan aikin, zurfin ruwa, dangantaka, haɗin gwiwar alamomin kuɗi, iyakoki, da hanyar sayarwa duk suna da mahimmanci.

Wannan yana nufin cewa ba a ɗaukar GHO a matsayin amincewa gaba ɗaya ga kowanne haɗin ba. Avana yana goyon bayan tsarin rukunin, ba kawai alamar kayan aikin ba.

questions.q: Yaya zan biya bashin GHO?
questions.a:
Bashin GHO ana biya shi cikin GHO tare da riba da duk wasu kudade da suka dace. Da zarar an tabbatar da biyan bashin, Avana yana rage bashin da ke kan asusun kuma yanayin lafiya yana inganta.

Bayan an biya gaba daya, an saki takunkumin jinginar da ke da alaƙa da wannan bashin bisa ga ƙa'idodin kasuwa, yana ba da damar cire ko canza matsayin LP idan babu wani bashi da ya rage.

questions.q: Menene Avana Multiply?
questions.a:
Avana Multiply shine tsarin aikin ƙarfin amfani da rance da aka kula da shi wanda aka gina a saman bashi da LP ya tallafa. Mai amfani yana ajiye jinginar LP da aka goyi bayan, Avana yana tantance kimarta, kuma fuskar mai amfani za ta iya amfani da wannan ikon aron don buɗe zagaye ko ƙarfin amfani da aka amince da shi daga wata hanya guda.

Maimakon aron da hannu, musayar, sake ajiya, da bibiyar bashi a cikin kayan aiki da yawa, Multiply yana haɗa matsayin cikin tsarin aiki guda ɗaya da ake sa ido akai tare da jingina, bashi, matakin ƙarfin amfani, factor lafiyar, da ƙa'idodin warwarewa da aka nuna tare.

questions.q: Ta yaya Multiply ya bambanta da aron?
questions.a:
Arzikin haya yana ba masu amfani kadarorin da za su iya amfani da su kai tsaye, muddin asusun yana cikin koshin lafiya. Multiply yana amfani da ikon aron da aka tallafawa da LP a cikin dabarun da aka sarrafa, inda babban jari da aka aro ake kaiwa cikin izini da bin sawu a matsayin matsayi guda.

Saboda Multiply yana ƙara leverage, zai iya ƙara ingancin babban jari da yiwuwar samun riba, amma hakan kuma yana ƙara haɗarin raguwa, haɗarin sayarwa na wajibi, da jin raɗaɗin motsi na farashi. Duban lafiya yana da mahimmanci fiye da yadda ba shi da mahimmanci, lokacin da matsayi ya kasance mai maimaitawa.

questions.q: Shin zan ci gaba da riƙe LP na yayin amfani da Multiply?
questions.a:
Eh. Matsayin LP yana ci gaba da zama tushen jingina yayin da matsayin Multiply yake bude. Mai amfani ba ya bukatar ficewa gaba daya daga matsayin AMM kawai don ƙirƙirar amfani da leverage.

LP yana ci gaba da tallafawa bashi, don haka yana ci gaba da ƙarƙashin ƙa'idodin jingina da kuma tarwatsawa idan asusun ya zama marar lafiya. Masu amfani suna sa ido kan ƙimar jingina, bashi, leverage, da buffer na tarwatsawa a duk tsawon rayuwar zagayowar.

questions.q: Menene ke iyakance mafi girman amfani da rance?
questions.a:
Matsakaicin amfani da rance ya dogara da ingancin jinginar abun more rayuwa, ruwa a cikin pool, tashin hankali, amincewar malami, kadarar da aka aro, kasuwar ciki, da tsammanin karbar bashi. Tafkuna masu dorewa ko masu alaƙa sosai galibi suna iya goyan bayan iyakokin amfani da rance daban da tafkuna masu tashin hankali ko marasa yawa.

Avana yana amfani da matakan sarrafa haɗari na kasuwa musamman don haka amfani da rance yana da iyaka ta gaske bisa jinginar LP da ke bayan matsayin maimakon amfani da mai ninki madaidaici da aka yi wa kowane pool.

questions.q: Shin atomatik na iya taimakawa wajen sarrafa haɗarin matsayi?
questions.a:
Atomatik yana sa ido kan lafiyar asusun kuma zai iya tayar da ayyuka da aka riga aka tsara kamar biyan bashin, rage amfani da bashi, ko rage fuskantar hadari kafin a sayar da dukiya. Wannan yana da muhimmanci saboda matsayin da LP ke goyan baya yana motsawa tare da tarawa bashi da sauye-sauyen kasuwa na matakin pooln.

Atomatik kayan aiki ne na kula da haɗari, ba tabbaci ba. Ana iya shafar aiwatarwa har yanzu ta motsin kasuwa, yanayin ruwa, jinkirin mu'amala, sabuntawar na'ura mai gani, da samuwar hanyoyi.

questions.q: Shin jinginar LP na iya tallafawa irin haɗarin perps?
questions.a:
Hadin gwiwar LP yana tallafawa leverage da aka amince da shi ko kuma exposure irin na perps ta hanyar kasuwanni da haɗin gwiwa da ke tura bashi da LP ke tallafawa cikin dabaru da aka sarrafa. Matsayin LP yana ƙirƙirar ikon aro, kuma za a iya amfani da wannan bashi ta hanyoyin exposure da aka tallafawa maimakon a yi amfani da shi kawai a matsayin aro na walat mai sauƙi.

Samuwar ya ƙayyade ta hanyar tsarin kasuwa mai aiki: nau'in jinginar, sigogin kasuwa, amincin oraku, ruwa, kadarorin bashi, da hanyar haɗin gwiwa. Fuskar tana nuna hanyoyin da aka tallafawa don kowace kasuwa.

questions.q: Me masu amfani ke sa ido a kai bayan buɗe matsayi?
questions.a:
Masu amfani suna sa ido kan matsayin lafiya, amfani da aron kudi, ƙimar jingina, ci gaban bashi, yanayin kewayon LP, tattarawar kuɗi, da ajiyar rushewa. Ga matsayi na Multiply, suna kuma sa ido kan matakin leverage da sarrafa cirewa.

Avana yana bayyana waɗannan ƙimar a cikin hanyoyin amfani don haka masu amfani za su iya ganin lokacin da matsayi yake cikin lafiya, lokacin da ya kamata a kula da shi, da kuma lokacin da haɗari yake matsowa kusa da rushewa.
